questions.question: Define food adulteration.
questions.solution_html:
• ● Food adulteration is the intentional or unintentional addition of inferior or harmful
  • substances to food or removal of valuable components. ((1 mark))
  • ● It reduces food quality, safety, and nutritional value. ((1 mark))
questions.final_answer: ● It reduces food quality, safety, and nutritional value. ()
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: List the three types of food hazards.
questions.solution_html:
• List the three types of food hazards. ((2 marks))
  • ● Biological hazards – microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, fungi. (0.5)
  • ● Chemical hazards – pesticides, toxins, heavy metals. (0.5)
  • ● Physical hazards – foreign objects like glass, metal, stones. (0.5)
  • ● Correct listing of hazards. (0.5)
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Describe biological, physical and chemical hazards and explain their effects on food safety.
questions.solution_html:

  • Biological hazards ((3 marks))
  • ● Bacteria (Salmonella, E.coli) (1)
  • ● Viruses (1)
  • ● Fungi parasites (1)
  • Physical hazards ((3 marks))
  • ● Glass pieces (1)
  • ● Metal fragments (1)
  • ● Stones, hair, plastic (1)
  • Chemical hazards ((4 marks))
  • ● Pesticide residues (1)
  • ● Heavy metals (1)

  • ● Cleaning chemicals toxins (1)

questions.question: State the functions and responsibilities of FSSAI.
questions.solution_html:
• Functions of FSSAI ((10 marks))
  • ● Formulate food safety standards (2)
  • ● Regulate manufacture, storage and sale of food (2)
  • ● Issue licenses to food businesses (2)
  • ● Ensure food quality and safety (2)
  • ● Promote food safety awareness and research (2)
questions.final_answer: ● Promote food safety awareness and research
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain Role of hydrocolloids in texture.
questions.solution_html:
• Role of hydrocolloids in texture ((10 marks))
  • ● Increase viscosity (2)
  • ● Stabilize emulsions (2)
  • ● Control moisture (2)
  • ● Improve mouthfeel (2)
  • ● Examples: pectin, guar gum, xanthan gum (2)
questions.final_answer: ● Examples: pectin, guar gum, xanthan gum

questions.question: Define relative sweetness and compare the sweetness of common sugars including sucrose, glucose, fructose, and maltose
questions.solution_html:
• Relative sweetness of sugars ((10 marks))
  • Definition
  • ● Relative sweetness is the sweetness level of a substance compared with sucrose (standard
  • value = 100). ((3 marks))
  • Comparison
  • ● Fructose – sweetest (2)
  • ● Sucrose – reference sugar (2)
  • ● Glucose – moderately sweet (1.5)
  • ● Maltose – least sweet (1.5)
  • [10 × 2 = (20 Marks)]
